task_description.overview: Generate exploratory plots for spatial, temporal, and magnitude distribution patterns of the seismic catalog.
steps: Load the Catalog object with the required columns (time, latitude, longitude, magnitude).
Plot event locations on a map using cat.plot_in_space(include_map=True).
Plot magnitudes over time with cat.plot_mags_in_time().
Plot the cumulative frequency-magnitude distribution using cat.plot_cum_fmd() with a specified bin size.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Given the earthquake catalog file {catalog_path}, using the `seismostats` library to produce some figures: 1) a map of event locations with `cat.plot_in_space(include_map=True)`, 2) a time series of magnitudes with `cat.plot_mags_in_time()`, and 3) the cumulative frequency-magnitude distribution with bin size {fmd_bin} using `cat.plot_cum_fmd(fmd_bin={fmd_bin})`. 
 Note: 1) Save the spatial distribution plot to {spatial_distribution_plot}, the temporal distribution plot to {temporal_distribution_plot}, and the frequency magnitude distribution plot to {frequency_magnitude_distribution_plot}.
